newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares mixed, some profit-taking seen.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares mixed, some profit-taking seen.

text.p: Zimbabwean shares traded mixed to firmer on Monday but brokers said they expected the market to come off amidst some profit-taking this week.
The main industrial index put on 3.95 points to close at a new all time high of 11,976.07.
"The market has had its run and it's more likely to come off this week on some profit-taking," one broker said.

Among the day's winners, timber producer Border rose 50 cents to 1,650 while carbonated drinks manufacturer Schweppes, glass firm PGI and engineering group Gullivers added 10 cents each to 460, 510 and 310 respectively.
Against the trend, merchant banker FMB dropped 300 cents to 4,500, home appliances-maker Capri shed 45 cents to 450 and investment group TZI lost 10 cents to 950.
Minings continued queit with gold producer Falgold trading four cents up at 75. The mining index edged up 2.02 points to 866.50.
